command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
echo "a9910edb1fa76136e66ae1f3406829e7eaeceaa9b13d5a4a1b1fb4752e44ac21  compare.py" | sha256sum -c --quiet || { echo "FAIL: compare.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
for c in arm64 intel amd; do mkdir -p s/$c && tar -C s/$c -xf $c.tar && ls s/$c/sample | wc -l; done
python3 -u compare.py s/arm64/sample s/intel/sample s/amd/sample > compare.txt 2>&1
RC=$?
cat compare.txt
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: compare"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
